Simulate data for evaluating feature-weighting schemes (variance vs CV)

Source: R/simulate-weighting.R
simulate_weighting_regime.Rd

Generates a multi-source data set with a known cluster structure in which the discriminative signal is carried either by high-absolute-variance features (regime = "variance") or by high-coefficient-of-variation features buried under high-abundance, high-variance decoys (regime = "cv"). It is intended for benchmarking the "var", "cv" and "nugget" weightings of the ABC family (and any other feature-weighting method) on the same footing.

Usage

simulate_weighting_regime(
  regime = c("cv", "variance"),
  n_samples = 120,
  n_clusters = 3,
  n_sources = 2,
  n_signal = 40,
  n_decoy = 500,
  n_noise = 60,
  effect = NULL,
  seed = NULL
)

Arguments

regime

"cv" (default) or "variance"; see Details.

n_samples

Number of objects (rows), split evenly across clusters.

n_clusters

Number of clusters.

n_sources

Number of data sources (independent draws of the same design).

n_signal, n_decoy, n_noise

Numbers of discriminative, decoy (non-discriminative but high-variance in the CV regime) and pure-noise features per source.

effect

Between-cluster mean shift on the signal features (defaults: 1.4 for the variance regime, 0.9 for the cv regime).

seed

Optional RNG seed.

Value

A list with List (the sources, objects in rows), truth (cluster labels), signal_features (indices of the discriminative features), regime and params.

See also

M_ABC (the weighting argument), mosaic_sim

Examples

cv  <- simulate_weighting_regime("cv", seed = 1)
# variance weighting is misled by high-abundance decoys, CV recovers the truth:
fit_var <- M_ABC(cv$List, numsim = 80, NC = 3, weighting = c("var", "var"))
#> M_ABC: source 1 of 2 (weighting = var) ...
#> M_ABC: source 2 of 2 (weighting = var) ...
#> M_ABC: building consensus dissimilarity (C++ kernel) ...
fit_cv  <- M_ABC(cv$List, numsim = 80, NC = 3, weighting = c("cv",  "cv"))
#> M_ABC: source 1 of 2 (weighting = cv) ...
#> M_ABC: source 2 of 2 (weighting = cv) ...
#> M_ABC: building consensus dissimilarity (C++ kernel) ...
c(var = cluster_agreement(mosaic_labels(fit_var, 3), cv$truth)[["ARI"]],
  cv  = cluster_agreement(mosaic_labels(fit_cv,  3), cv$truth)[["ARI"]])
#>         var          cv 
#> 0.002749162 0.002861820
